scope: Entire actual final collector and actual full-code read receipt reread as static text; no acquisition, collector execution, network, mathematical content or source archive inspection.

resolved_findings.mechanism: NFC+casefold alias registry checks every native path prefix, including implicit directories, before member extraction.
Directory ZIP entries with nonzero uncompressed size are rejected before extraction.

Native permission 000 is preserved whenever full native Unix mode is nonzero. Fallback permissions apply only when full native mode is zero; both original mode and effective filesystem mode remain recorded.
os.walk now receives a raising onerror callback; scan errors cannot silently skip subtrees through that documented error path. Subsequent lstat, digest and directory checks also propagate errors.
Preflight uses orig_filename and rejects any difference from ZipInfo.filename before path handling; NUL rejection now sees original decoded spelling.

additional_static_evidence.mechanism: Static source introspection of ZipInfo.__init__ and _sanitize_filename confirmed orig_filename is stored before NUL truncation; no archive was constructed or read.
preserved_checks: raw API/page source bytes and native full metadata
published file order and native filenames
literal MD5 plus independent padded comparison and byte length
safe paths, no links/devices/encryption or exact duplicates
outer controlling paper.pdf distinct from embedded PDF pins
fresh sources only with exclusive writes
finite manifest/final plus external pins without circularity

limitations: Static pass grants no execution or publication authority and is not an actual-source or runtime verification.
A two-record partial failure may leave first-record SOURCE_FINAL before the shared external pin file exists; report the overall acquisition incomplete and never overwrite existing source folders.
Native restrictive directory/file modes may prevent subsequent manifesting and fail closed; collector does not repair source modes.

Python os.walk can classify an entry as a nondirectory after an entry-type query error; no runtime I/O fault-injection audit was performed. Independent post-acquisition topology reconciliation remains useful.
Initial GET origins are restricted to zenodo.org; redirect destinations are recorded but not restricted before following.
Immutability remains procedural rather than OS-enforced.
